hypotheses.title: Intraday session-bounded mean-reversion beats swing on FTMO first-passage
Trade density, not per-trade edge, is the binding FTMO constraint
A recurring daily-loss-cluster condition can be excluded by a mechanical no-trade filter

lessons: The proven inventory's swing profile (D1/H1/H4, low density, overnight swap tail) is structurally the OPPOSITE of the FTMO-fit profile; adding more swing cousins cannot close the FTMO gap. FTMO edge must come from a higher-density, session-flat, low-swap intraday direction.
question: What type of mechanical edge is our FTMO book missing? (directive §47)
